examples: Let an agent check the page it just built, while you watch the same browser.
An agent opens a page it made for you; a row with its title appears in your left sidebar's browser list and the page fills the center screen, where a session's terminal shows.
Pop a browser or a page out into its own window, like a tab torn out of a browser.
Pop out a proxy browser showing localhost:3000 from your phone: the real page is off (it only resolves on the computer carnivore runs on), so pop out the proxy instead.
how_to: Add a browser component to a session and enter a URL.
Drive it from the page; the agent can use the same browser.

Let an agent call browser_open, or press open in tab on a task manager page card: a task manager page or a Carnivore pop-out page becomes a page row in the left sidebar's browser list, shown in the center screen on every window and still there after a reload; an http(s) url becomes a browser row there.
Press pop out on a browser or page row's key or menu: a page opens in its own tab, and a proxy browser asks every time whether to pop out the proxy or open the real page in your own browser.

Hold shift in the left sidebar: every browser and page row's kebab turns into a red x that closes that row (a page at once, a proxy browser after its confirm); let go of shift and the kebabs come back.
Press the trash key at the end of a proxy browser's address bar to close it: it asks first, since its cookies and logins go with it.
Type an address into a proxy browser: it loads on the computer carnivore runs on, so localhost is that computer's; the note under the address bar says so.
media_exempt: starts a real headless Chromium that loads external pages; not reproducible in a capture slot
name: Remote browser sessions
summary: open a real, remotely controlled web browser on the computer carnivore runs on, named a proxy browser, inside a session to test or research a page; pages an agent opens for you share its sidebar list and center screen, either kind pops out into its own tab, and a proxy browser asks every time whether to pop out the proxy or open the real page.
where: The components menu, or a session's add component list, then proxy browser.
The browser list in the left sidebar: remote browsers and pages an agent opened for you, each with a pop out key; while shift is held every row shows a red close x.
